'''Joey Martin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[June 2001 Raleigh tournament (9 June)]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|BHBM]], according to Philip Marschall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2425">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01d2425/ raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01], DeckTech (Philip "WorldChamp" Marschall, 9 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-09-raleigh-nc-foundations-edge-6-9-01d2425/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
